brief.claim: In adult rats, animals given the drug have a larger heart weight than untreated animals after accounting for body mass: in a linear regression of heart weight on treatment status and body mass, the coefficient of treatment status is positive and significant at the one-sided 5% level (t test).

data_keys.meaning: Wet heart weight of each animal, in mg.
Body mass of each animal, in g.
True for animals given the drug, False for untreated animals.

brief.sizes: animals = 48; heart_weight, body_mass and treated each have shape (48,).

brief.claim: Among adults, 24-hour urinary albumin excretion increases with age after accounting for 24-hour urinary creatinine excretion: the partial correlation between albumin excretion and age, given creatinine excretion, is at least 0.15.

data_keys.meaning: Urinary albumin excreted over 24 hours, in mg per 24 h, for each participant.
Urinary creatinine excreted over 24 hours, in mg per 24 h, for each participant.
Age of each participant, in years.

brief.sizes: participants = 800; albumin_excretion, creatinine_excretion and age each have shape (800,).

brief.claim: In patients attending a hypertension clinic, left ventricular mass adds explanatory power for systolic blood pressure beyond body surface area: the gain in R-squared when left ventricular mass is added to a linear regression of systolic pressure on body surface area is at least 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: Left ventricular mass of each patient from echocardiography, in g.
Body surface area of each patient, in square metres.
Resting systolic blood pressure of each patient, in mmHg.

brief.sizes: patients = 300; lv_mass, body_surface_area and systolic_bp each have shape (300,).

brief.claim: In adult mice, liver weight is positively related to kidney weight after accounting for body mass: the coefficient of kidney weight in a linear regression of liver weight on kidney weight and body mass is at least 0.25 (g of liver weight per g of kidney weight).

data_keys.meaning: Wet liver weight of each mouse, in g.
Combined wet weight of both kidneys of each mouse, in g.
Body mass of each mouse, in g.

brief.sizes: mice = 150; liver_weight, kidney_weight and body_mass each have shape (150,).

brief.claim: Across adult skeletons, femur length and tibia length are positively associated after accounting for humerus length: the partial correlation between femur length and tibia length, given humerus length, is at least 0.3.

data_keys.meaning: Maximum length of the femur of each skeleton, in mm.
Maximum length of the tibia of each skeleton, in mm.
Maximum length of the humerus of each skeleton, in mm.

brief.sizes: skeletons = 1000; femur_length, tibia_length and humerus_length each have shape (1000,).

brief.claim: Across trials of an estimation task, the estimates of the three observers are positively associated after accounting for the true value of the quantity: the mean, over the three pairs of observers, of the partial correlation between the two observers' estimates given the true value is at least 0.2.

data_keys.meaning: Actual value of the quantity presented on each trial, in arbitrary units.
Estimate of the quantity made by each observer on each trial, in the same units as true_value.

brief.sizes: trials = 200, observers = 3; true_value has shape (200,); estimates has shape (200, 3).

brief.claim: Within crustacean species, claw length rises with abdomen length after accounting for total body length: across species, the mean of the within-species coefficients of abdomen length in a linear regression of claw length on abdomen length and body length is at least 0.15.

data_keys.meaning: Abdomen length of each measured individual, in mm.
Length of the larger claw of each measured individual, in mm.
Total body length of each measured individual, in mm.

brief.sizes: species = 15, individuals = 40 per species; abdomen_length, claw_length and body_length each have shape (15, 40).

brief.claim: In adults with hypertension, the fall in systolic pressure over a 12-week programme is larger in patients with a higher starting pressure: the correlation, across patients, between the fall (first baseline reading minus week-12 reading) and the second baseline reading is at least 0.3.

data_keys.meaning: Systolic blood pressure, first reading at the baseline visit, in mmHg.
Systolic blood pressure, second reading at the baseline visit, in mmHg.
Systolic blood pressure at the week-12 visit, in mmHg.

brief.sizes: patients = 120; sbp_baseline_first, sbp_baseline_second and sbp_week12 each have shape (120,).

brief.claim: Across critically ill patients, whole-body oxygen uptake measured by expired-gas analysis is positively correlated with systemic oxygen delivery (cardiac output times arterial oxygen content): the Pearson correlation is at least 0.3.

data_keys.meaning: Cardiac output of each patient by thermodilution, in L/min.
Arterial blood oxygen content of each patient, in mL O2 per dL.
Mixed venous blood oxygen content of each patient, in mL O2 per dL.
Whole-body oxygen uptake of each patient from expired-gas analysis, in mL/min.

brief.sizes: patients = 60; cardiac_output, arterial_o2_content, venous_o2_content and o2_uptake_expired each have shape (60,).

brief.claim: In a symptom checklist of eight items, the score on item 1 identifies patients with a high total on items 2 to 8: the AUC of the item 1 score for patients whose total over items 2 to 8 is at least 12, against all other patients, is at least 0.65.

data_keys.meaning: Points (0 to 3) scored by each patient on each of the eight checklist items; columns are in checklist order, item 1 first.

brief.claim: Across tumour samples, the expression of gene A and the expression of gene B are positively related after accounting for the expression of gene C: the gain in R-squared when gene A expression is added to a linear regression of gene B expression on gene C expression is at least 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: Quantitative PCR expression signal of gene A in each tumour sample, in arbitrary linear units.
Quantitative PCR expression signal of gene B in each tumour sample, in arbitrary linear units.
Quantitative PCR expression signal of gene C in each tumour sample, in arbitrary linear units.

brief.sizes: samples = 96; gene_a_expression, gene_b_expression and gene_c_expression each have shape (96,).

brief.claim: Over a ten-year record, monthly hospital admissions rose after accounting for catchment population: in a linear regression of monthly admissions on time and catchment population, the coefficient of time is positive and significant at the one-sided 5% level (t test).

data_keys.meaning: Number of hospital admissions in each month.
Catchment population in each month, in thousands.
Time of each month in years since the start of the record.

brief.sizes: months = 120; admissions, population and time_years each have shape (120,).
